verdict.rationale: OCI documents budgets that set soft spending limits, with alerts that warn when you might exceed them, which covers the budgets-and-alerts part of the story. The evidence contains nothing on spend anomaly detection, a core element of the story, and budgets are explicitly soft limits rather than hard caps. Missing for 10: documented spend anomaly detection, evidence that budgets and alerts can be set up from day one, independent or hands-on corroboration that alerts fire reliably.
